summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of its own ordinary shares for cancellation, as part of a buy-back announced on 5 August 2026. On 8 September 2026, the company repurchased 10,000 shares on UK venues at an average price of £15.6524 per share and 499,200 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at an average price of HK$165.8736, with a total consideration of US$555.1 million since the buy-back's commencement. Shares were cancelled, reducing issued ordinary share capital. Watch for continued execution of the ongoing buy-back program and subsequent total voting rights announcements.
